prompt_policy: Contact only when right hand/fingers/palm visibly touches or holds the object; near/ambiguous is false.

decisions.reason: Right hand is near but there is a visible gap from the scanner/base; no clear touching or grasping.
The person's right hand is reaching toward the scanner but there is a visible gap; no clear touching or grasping.
The person's right hand is reaching toward the scanner but remains visibly separated with a gap; no touching or grasping is shown.
The person's right hand is extended toward the scanner but there is a clear visible gap; no touching or grasping is visible.
Right hand is hovering near the scanner with a visible gap; no clear physical touch.
Right fingertips visibly overlap and touch the top/side of the pink scanner with no clear gap.
Right hand is hovering near the scanner with a visible gap and no clear physical touch.
The person's right hand is hovering above the scanner with a visible gap and no clear physical touch.
The person's right hand is hovering above/near the pink scanner with a visible gap and no clear physical touch.
Right hand is hovering near the scanner tip, but visible contact is not clear and a small gap/ambiguity remains.
Right hand is very close to the scanner but no clear visible touching or overlap is evident.
The person's right fingers visibly overlap and press against the pink scanner near its top, indicating contact.
